dataset: INSPIRE Index Polygons — local authority downloads
evidence_slice: HM Land Registry's official Use land and property data service publishes INSPIRE Index Polygons by local authority and includes an Exeter City Council download row. The service states that Index polygons show the indicative extent and position of registered freehold properties in England and Wales and that the data is supplied under the Open Government Licence. This geometry is property/parcel extent rather than a physical building footprint, and the distribution metadata does not provide record-bound building type/use evidence.

field_evidence.footprint: Official service defines Index polygons as indicative extents/positions of registered freehold properties; this is property/parcel extent, not a physical building footprint.
field_evidence.type_use: Selected Exeter City Council distribution metadata provides no record-bound building type/use field.
field_evidence.service: HM Land Registry official Use land and property data service; public no-login local-authority download index under OGL.
